definitions.gloss: depth, distance from front to back
definitions.explanation: The measurement from the front to the back of an object, room, or space. Also used figuratively to describe richness or profundity.

examples.japanese: この{棚|たな}の{奥行|おくゆ}きは30センチです。
examples.english: This shelf has a depth of 30 centimeters.

examples.japanese: {部屋|へや}は{狭|せま}いが{奥行|おくゆ}きがある。
examples.english: The room is narrow but has depth.

examples.japanese: この{写真|しゃしん}は{奥行|おくゆ}きのある{構図|こうず}で、{遠近感|えんきんかん}がよく{出|で}ている。
examples.english: This photo has a composition with depth, and the sense of perspective comes through well.

notes:
WRITING:
{奥|おく} (interior/deep) + {行|ゆ}き (going). Literally "going to the back."

USAGE:
Primarily a spatial measurement term used in architecture, furniture, and interior design. Also used figuratively: {奥行|おくゆ}きのある{作品|さくひん} (a work with depth/complexity) or {奥行|おくゆ}きのある{味|あじ} (a flavor with depth).

When shopping for furniture or appliances in Japan, the three standard dimensions are: {幅|はば} (width), {高|たか}さ (height), and {奥行|おくゆ}き (depth).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {奥行|おくゆ}きがある: to have depth
- {奥行|おくゆ}き30センチ: 30cm deep
- {奥行|おくゆ}きのある: with depth (modifier)
- {奥行|おくゆ}きを{出|だ}す: to create a sense of depth
